facts.text: The boutique hotel is in San Diego's Gaslamp District, downtown.
facts.excerpt: Explore Downtown San Diego from our Boutique Gaslamp District Hotel

facts.text: The hotel's historic building opened in 1913 for the World's Fair celebrating the Panama Canal.
facts.excerpt: Opened in 1913 for the World’s Fair celebrating the Panama Canal, this historic building is a half mile from Petco Park.

facts.text: The hotel is a half mile from Petco Park.
facts.excerpt: this historic building is a half mile from Petco Park

facts.text: The hotel has the Gaslamp Quarter's largest rooftop, with a restaurant, bar and pool.
facts.excerpt: the Gaslamp Quarter's largest rooftop, featuring a restaurant, bar and pool

facts.text: At the rooftop pool, guests can reserve a day pass, cabana or daybed with skyline views.
facts.excerpt: Reserve a day pass, cabana or daybed and enjoy skyline views, refreshing cocktails and poolside bites in a laid-back setting.

facts.text: The Andaz Cabana Suite has access to a private poolside cabana via a spiral staircase.
facts.excerpt: Make your stay extraordinary with access to a private poolside cabana via a spiral staircase from this oversized suite in the heart of the Gaslamp Quarter.

facts.text: The Andaz Sweet Suite is a top-floor suite with city views, an eight-person dining table and two bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: extravagant top-floor suite, featuring sleek furnishings and local artwork. The inviting space includes a huge living area with a sectional sofa, an eight-person dining table, two bathrooms

facts.text: The Andaz Star Suite has a living area with wet bar, king bunk beds and an additional king bed in a separate room.
facts.excerpt: an opulent urban sanctuary with a spacious living area and wet bar. This suite features dramatic artwork by local artists, king bunk beds, plus an additional king bed in a separate room.

facts.text: Rooms and suites feature local art and vibrant decor reflecting the Gaslamp Quarter.
facts.excerpt: living spaces that express the creative spirit of the Gaslamp Quarter through local art and vibrant decor

facts.text: The Rooftop by STK is the hotel's open-air rooftop restaurant.
facts.excerpt: The Rooftop by STK embodies the spirit of San Diego—open air energy, coastal sophistication, and effortless style.

facts.text: STK Steakhouse has a central lounge with leather banquettes, theatrical lighting and a DJ.
facts.excerpt: The central lounge's leather banquettes are surrounded by an elevated dining room offering a more formal atmosphere. Theatrical lights illuminate each table and large windows provide a view into San Diego while a DJ sets the mood.

facts.text: Registered guests can join a complimentary beer and wine tasting in the lobby each evening.
facts.excerpt: join us in the lobby for a complimentary beer and wine tasting, for registered hotel guests only

facts.text: The hotel welcomes dogs, with dog beds, Andaz bowls and a treat at the front desk.
facts.excerpt: Your canine companion can lounge in one of our cozy dog beds, stay hydrated with water from our Andaz bowls and get energized from a treat at the front desk

facts.text: Parking at the hotel is by valet.
facts.excerpt: Valet Parking Only

facts.text: San Diego International Airport is 2.5 miles from the hotel.
facts.excerpt:
San Diego International Airport (SAN)

2.5 Miles

facts.text: The hotel has a fitness center.
facts.excerpt: - Fitness Center

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes the hotel was originally the Ivy Hotel.
facts.excerpt: the voyeuristic vibe is really built around more subtle features at the Andaz (originally the Ivy Hotel)

facts.text: The rooftop venue overlooking downtown San Diego and the Gaslamp Quarter hosts weddings.
facts.excerpt: Say “I do” on our rooftop venue overlooking downtown San Diego and the Gaslamp Quarter

facts.text: The hotel calls itself one of San Diego's finest hotels.
facts.excerpt: Experience one of San Diego's finest hotels

facts.text: The hotel is surrounded by vibrant nightlife, upscale dining and popular attractions.
facts.excerpt: Our boutique hotel is surrounded by vibrant nightlife, upscale dining and popular attractions.
